title: Improving Consistency Models with Generator-Augmented Flows
tldr_zh: 证明 CT 与 CD 差异在连续时间不消失；用一致性模型预测端点与同一噪声重配对（GC）降低该差异与传输成本，CIFAR-10 FID 7.42→5.95。
tldr_en: Proves the CT-CD gap persists in continuous time (regularizer R depends on velocity-estimator misalignment); generator-augmented coupling re-pairs predicted endpoints with the same noise, lowering R and transport cost, FID 7.42 to 5.95 on CIFAR-10.
key_numbers: ECT CIFAR-10 long training: IC 4.11 vs GC 3.74; ImageNet-64 long: IC 5.84 vs GC 6.39 (Table 2)
Iso wall-clock iCT-GC 6.38 vs iCT-IC 7.42; ~20% overhead (Table 3, App. C.1)
Theorem 1: lim N^alpha (L_CT - L_CD) = C T^(alpha-1) R(theta) > 0
R_tilde: GC < batch-OT (b=512) < IC for all sigma (Fig. 2)
